steps.en: Clone the repo inside a CUDA PyTorch container and install it in place
steps.zh: 在带 CUDA 的 PyTorch 容器里克隆仓库并就地安装

steps.en: Point the file-inference script at the model id and your recording
steps.zh: 把推理脚本指向模型名和你的录音文件

steps.en: Downloads the 7B checkpoint from Hugging Face and loads it in bfloat16 on the GPU
steps.zh: 下载 7B 权重，以 bfloat16 加载到 GPU

steps.en: Squeezes the whole recording, up to 60 minutes, into 7.5 speech frames per second
steps.zh: 把整段录音（最长 60 分钟）压成每秒 7.5 帧的语音表示

steps.en: The language model writes one JSON transcript: start time, end time, speaker ID and text per segment
steps.zh: 语言模型一次写出 JSON 转写：每段的起止时间、说话人编号和文字

component.zh: 基于 Qwen2.5 的解码器

value.en: Who said what and when for an hour-long recording from one model call — no separate diarization model, aligner or chunk-stitching code to maintain
value.zh: 一次模型调用就拿到一小时录音的“谁、何时、说了什么”——不用再维护说话人分离模型、对齐器和分块拼接代码

sources: https://github.com/microsoft/VibeVoice docs/vibevoice-asr.md (Installation: NVIDIA PyTorch container nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:25.12-py3, git clone, `pip install -e .`; Usage 2: `python demo/vibevoice_asr_inference_from_file.py --model_path microsoft/VibeVoice-ASR --audio_files [add an audio path here]`; Key Features: 60 minutes within 64K token length, joint ASR + diarization + timestamping)

https://github.com/microsoft/VibeVoice demo/vibevoice_asr_inference_from_file.py (from_pretrained with dtype bfloat16 on CUDA; --max_new_tokens default 32768; post_process_transcription -> segments with start_time/end_time/speaker_id/text)

https://github.com/microsoft/VibeVoice vibevoice/processor/vibevoice_asr_processor.py (target_sample_rate=24000, speech_tok_compress_ratio=3200 -> 7.5 frames/s; system prompt 'transcribes audio input into text output in JSON format'; keys 'Start time', 'End time', 'Speaker ID', 'Content')

https://github.com/microsoft/VibeVoice vibevoice/modular/modeling_vibevoice_asr.py (acoustic_tokenizer + semantic_tokenizer); https://huggingface.co/microsoft/VibeVoice-ASR config.json (decoder_config model_type qwen2, hidden_size 3584, 28 layers); README Risks section (Qwen2.5 base model)
